Client portal

Scheduling, payment and intake paperwork run through the practice's client portal rather than through this website, because a portal is built to hold clinical information and a public web page is not. Existing clients book and reschedule sessions, pay by card, and complete forms there. Blue Cross Blue Shield is accepted; the self-pay rate is $240 for a 50-minute session.

Ask for your portal link See fees

Note for the site build: set portal.url and portal.name in src/_data/site.js and every button on this page, the client forms page and the contact page turns into a direct portal link. The content security policy in src/_headers does not need changing for a plain link; it only needs the portal host added if the portal is ever embedded in a frame on this site.

If you are new

The portal is for people who have already started. A first contact goes through the consult instead: fifteen minutes, free, and the point of it is to work out whether this is the right fit before anyone books anything.

After the consult you get a portal invitation, the forms, and a first appointment. That order matters, because the paperwork asks questions that only make sense once you know who you are working with.

Seeing an associate?

Each of the LPC Associates runs their own scheduling, billing and paperwork, so book and pay with them directly using the contact route on their card. Fees range from $100 to $165 a session with limited sliding-scale places.

Supervision and consultation

LPC supervision and EMDR consultation are not booked through the client portal. Supervision starts with an application, and consultation is scheduled directly.

  • LPC supervision, $425 a month, by application
  • EMDR consultation, $185 an hour, scheduled as needed

A note on security

No part of reemglascolpc.com asks for card numbers, insurance details or anything clinical. If a page claiming to be this practice does, it is not this practice. Payment happens inside the portal, on the portal's own domain.

Questions about booking and payment

How do I book a therapy session?

Existing clients book through the client portal. If you have not started yet, request a free 15-minute consult first; the portal invitation follows once you decide to go ahead. Clients of the practice's associates book directly with their associate.

How do I pay for a session?

By major credit card inside the client portal. Blue Cross Blue Shield is accepted and billed through insurance; sessions under any other plan are self-pay at $240 for 50 minutes. In-person walk therapy is paid in advance.

What happens if I cancel?

Telehealth appointments canceled at least 24 hours ahead cost nothing. Inside 24 hours an $85 fee may apply. Walk therapy is paid in advance and is not refunded for cancellations inside 48 hours.

Do I have to be in Texas for a telehealth session?

Yes. A Texas license allows a counselor to treat clients located in Texas, so both you and your therapist have to be physically in the state at the time of the session. Tell your therapist in advance if you are traveling, so the appointment can be moved rather than canceled.

Can I use the portal to reach my therapist between sessions?

For scheduling and admin, yes. It is not a crisis channel and messages are not monitored around the clock. If you are in crisis, call or text 988, or 911 if you are in immediate danger.

This practice does not provide emergency care. If you are in crisis, call or text 988 for the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline, or 911 if you are in immediate danger.
